typesense:popular.greeting:
For those who are too lazy to write their own porn, describe something and R34 will make a porn version. It could be anything from one or two words to a full description of your favorite scene from fiction, and it will be turned into porn. If you don't see porn in the first answer,
Type "continue" in the command line and porn will eventually appear in the scene. Or simply enter hints to get the scene where you want it to go faster.
typesense:popular.name: R34 Maker
typesense:popular.title: For those who are too lazy to write their own porn
